    The 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament games air across
    CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV. The Final Four and National Championship game are on TBS. Games can be streamed via the March Madness Live app, Paramount+, and Max (formerly HBO Max). 
    Key 2026 Tournament Channels & Streaming: 
    • Channels: CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
    • Streaming: March Madness Live, Paramount+ (for CBS games), and Max (for TBS/TNT/truTV games).
    • Final Four/Championship: TBS.
    • Women's Tournament: ABC and ESPN channels. 
    For cord-cutters, services such as DirecTV Stream, Fubo, Hulu + Live TV, and Sling TV include the necessary channels.
